title: Diebold Nixdorf Case Study | HatchWorks AI
description: A staffing company with branches across all 50 states, Puerto Rico and Canada. An aging platform that impeded employees’ job searches—and employers’ ability to find reliable and quality staff. A need to modernize the current organizational structure, create their own internal Product group, and develop a strategic solution focused on improving the user experience.
